podcast.title: Early Career Milestone (1975)
podcast.body: Reba McIntyre signed her first contract in 1975, marking the beginning of her career in the late 70s. "As we get into the late 70s, we are on the verge of the era of Reba McIntyre who signed her first contract in 1975 and the Juds."

podcast.title: Business Savvy and Branding
podcast.body: Like Loretta Lynn and Dolly Parton, Reba McIntyre established herself as a strong brand in the music industry from the 1980s onwards. "In many ways they became brands like Reba McIntyre did in the 80s and beyond that."

srcs.episode: Ep. 23 - Women of Country Music in the 70s

podcast.title: Critique of Nashville Industry (Contemporary)
podcast.body: Reba McIntyre has observed that the lack of female voices in contemporary country radio does not surprise her, attributing it to Nashville's enduring nature as a "good old boys network." "Reba McIntyre said that none of that surprises her because Nashville is still a good old boys network."
